annotations.title: Apply / dismiss Google Ads recommendations, or set auto-apply

description: Act on Google Ads recommendations by id. action:"apply" makes the change live immediately with no undo. Any spend-type recommendation (budget, bidding, keywords, network or audience expansion, new campaigns) or one touching a LIVE campaign is refused until the user says yes: call once without confirm, show the returned list, then call again with confirm:true and the confirmCount it named. The count is re-checked against a fresh read, and if any id is no longer on offer NOTHING is applied. action:"dismiss" only takes advice off the list and needs no confirm. action:"auto_apply" with autoApply:{TYPE:true|false} lets Google apply that type by itself; turning one ON needs confirm:true, OFF never does. dryRun validates and changes nothing. 0 credits.

action.description: apply (live now; spend types need confirm), dismiss (remove from list), or auto_apply (set auto-apply per type)

confirm.description: the user saw the list and said yes

confirmCount.description: apply: echo the count the unconfirmed call reported

customerId.description: 10-digit account id, omit for the brand’s default account

loginCustomerId.description: manager id if operating through an MCC

recommendationIds.description: apply/dismiss: ids from google_ads_recommendations, max 100; there is no "apply everything"
